audit.why: Packet levelChart (Bard x4, Skill x2, Janna) and content win[] already agree: Bard dominates early since Janna is a pure enabler pre-6, evens out once Monsoon comes online, and Janna's peel/shield scaling takes over late.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side are all 'Skill', but content win[0..3]='Bard', win[4..5]='Skill', win[6]='Janna' — the packet levelChart matches content exactly, so the full layer's chart never got updated.
audit.why: Bard has the stronger level 1-5 kit vs a pure-enabler pre-6 Janna (charged Q stun + Meep poke vs Tornado/shield-poke), evens at 6 when Monsoon answers the all-in, and Janna's shield/heal scaling plus disengage take over with items — exactly what content's whys already state.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1,2,3].side to 'Bard' and phases[6].side to 'Janna' (phases[4,5] already read 'Skill', matching win[4,5], so left alone) with matching why rewrites.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interaction (Janna sustains chip via Monsoon's heal; anti-heal timing matters) is already present in report[8] itemization, but that sentence misgenders Janna as 'his' — same bug flagged in report[9].
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists Janna as female; the owner is addressed as 'you' so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy.
audit.corrected: Fixed 'his' to 'her' in report[8].t and report[9].t.

edits.before: Meep-chip the contacts and collect the first chimes — the wanderer's ledger opens.
edits.after: You dominate level 1: charge Q through the wave and Meep-chip a passive enabler.

edits.before: Q threats begin: every wall adjacency is a stun audition.
edits.after: Charged-Q all-in threatens a kill her Tornado can't stop.

edits.before: Full kit: shrine the sustain, tunnel the angles, and Q the geometry.
edits.after: Compounding poke and Meeps keep Janna pressureless with no answer yet.

edits.before: Chime economy: collect on the move and return with meep upgrades — absence is investment.
edits.after: Your range and burst still out-trade her shield poke through levels 4 and 5, keeping tempo yours.

edits.before: Late Bard edits fights: R the engage or the objective, Q the chokes, and tunnel the team to the answer.
edits.after: With items her disengage and shield/heal scaling out-value your poke-and-pick style in every 5v5.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Janna Howling Gale (14s cd): matchup-defining — the charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Charge Q through the wave onto Janna and let your ADC follow — early trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Roaming off leaves your ADC to eat Tornado and shield-poke alone — a donation with intentions.

edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.
